prompt:
Edit the attached approved A-pose image into the B-pose for the same shot S09. This is a tightly limited animation pose edit, not a redesign or a new composition.

KEEP the same Xiaoman identity, face and puzzled expression, gaze, hairstyle and red pom-pom pigtails, head position, yellow polka-dot dress, torso, kneeling legs, red sandals, pale gray background, camera and framing. KEEP the anatomical LEFT supporting hand and its forearm exactly in the same pose as much as possible. KEEP the same red-and-silver flashlight in the same image position, size, rotation and unlit state; the left hand alone continues to support it from underneath just behind the silver head. Do not add another flashlight or another hand.

ONLY change the NEAR anatomical RIGHT arm and hand, the arm that currently grips the rear/middle red barrel with its thumb at the top switch. Release and REMOVE that old right gripping hand from the barrel. Naturally bend and raise that right forearm from its existing shoulder, bringing the right hand above the forward red barrel / rear edge of the silver flashlight head, ready to slap it gently downward. Elbow and wrist must remain anatomically believable, with unchanged limb length, not a stretched long arm. The raised right hand has its PALM FACING DOWN toward the flashlight; fingers are relaxed together and point generally to screen RIGHT. Show a small but CLEARLY VISIBLE AIR GAP between the lowest fingers/palm and the top of the flashlight, approximately half a child hand's thickness. This is the ANTICIPATION pose before the slap, NOT the impact pose. The hand must not touch, intersect, melt into, or pass through the silver head.

There are still exactly TWO hands total: one unchanged LEFT support hand under the flashlight and one RIGHT hand raised above it. Erase the old right gripping hand and thumb completely; cleanly reconstruct the small barrel/top-switch area revealed by removing them, matching the original red cylindrical flashlight and its existing black slide switch. No ghost hand or remaining extra fingers at the old grip. The flashlight must remain steady in the left hand. Do not alter the lower body or move the whole prop to meet the raised hand.

Preserve the existing clean 2D outlines, flat cel color style and neutral lighting. No motion lines, no light beam or glow, no onomatopoeia, no text. Keep the original native 1536x1024 canvas and safe framing. Return ONE edited image only.
